headline: Israel Election Results Show Netanyahu Bloc Loses Knesset Majority
summary: Final election results in Israel confirmed that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's coalition lost its majority in the Knesset, initiating complex coalition negotiations among diverse parties.
why: Political stability and coalition formation in Israel directly influence geopolitical risk premiums and domestic economic policies in the Middle East.

impacts.name: Israel
impacts.why: Loss of a parliamentary majority triggers coalition talks and potential shifts in government policy.
